newsitem.title: USA: USDA accepts DEIP dry milk, powder to Latin America.
newsitem.headline: USDA accepts DEIP dry milk, powder to Latin America.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Wednesday it accepted bids from two exporters for the sale of 51 tonnes of nonfat dry milk and 30 tonnes of whole milk powder to Caribbean, Central and South American nations under the Dairy Export Incentive Program.
Dry milk subsidy was was $690 a tonne, milk powder, $880.
Bonus for dry milk sales went to M.E. Franks Inc for 34 tonnes and to Agri-Best Dairy Products Inc for 17 tonnes. Delivery was set for December 18-February 28, 1997.
M.E. Franks also received bonus for the milk powder sale. Delivery was set for December 18-January 31, 1997.
